title: feat(github-tool): build a deterministic self-contained tool tarball
body:
First step of provisioning the GitHub tool as a versioned package instead of bundling it into the workflow entry.

- `build.ts` builds one `dist/index.js` that exports the read and write tool bundles through `interchange.tools`, with the Interchange agent runtime and the glob library inlined, Node target, no runtime dependencies, and packs it as `@corbits-github-tool-0.2.0.tgz` (17 KB) the way Interchange packs its built-in tool packages: sorted entries, portable headers, zero mtimes, fixed gzip header. Whitespace minification strips bundler path comments so the bytes do not depend on the install layout. The hash still depends on the pinned Bun version, which CI pins.
- `pack:tool` builds, packs and prints the sha512 integrity.
- Packed manifest: not private, `files` limited to dist and the manifest, `interchange.credentials` declares the github handle. Workspace exports are unchanged, so the hub and workflow still import source.
- `read-bundle.ts` removed; nothing imported it.

Verified: `bun run check`; github-tool tests (18) including a build test that packs twice and asserts identical integrity, inspects the packed manifest, asserts no path strings in the bundle, and loads the entry with real Node outside the workspace. Review confirmed the layout against Interchange's tool-packaging loader and filename pattern.

Refs CL-XXXX
